title: Three elements
source_text: Given an array a[1..n] with n positive integers. You can select any 3 different indices i, j, k and sum up the values a[i], a[j], a[k] . You need to output the maximum sum you can make by selecting some i, j, k. Input The first line contains an integer T indicating the number of test cases. For each test case, the first line contains n indicating the size of array a . Second line of each test case contains n space separated integers representing the array a . Output Output T lines in total. Each line starts with "Case #: " and followed by the maximum sum of 3 values. Here "#" is the number of the test case starting from 1. Constraints 1 ≤ T ≤ 30 3 ≤ n ≤ 100 1 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10000 Example Input: 2 4 1 2 3 4 4 1 2 1 1 Output: Case 1: 9 Case 2: 4 Explanation Test Case 1: You can select 2, 3, 4 and get the sum 2+3+4 = 9. Test Case 2: You can select 2, 1, 1 and get the sum 2+1+1 = 4.
